verdict.rationale: Poly's evidence covers sharing individual files/folders via links or team drives (poly-docs-9, poly-docs-24, poly-docs-33) and journaling/Mind notes storage, but there is no mention of publishing a collection of notes as a browsable, interlinked website (digital garden) with working cross-links. Sharing appears to be file/folder link-based, not a rendered site with navigable note-to-note links.
